description: This file implements the SensorInputMapper class, which manages sensor data processing, configuration, and event handling within the Android input system. It includes functions for converting sensor units, enabling/disabling sensors, processing hardware timestamps, and generating sensor events.

classes.name: SensorInputMapper
classes.description: Manages sensor input events, configuration, and data conversion for Android sensors.

methods.name: convertFromLinuxToAndroid
methods.description: Converts sensor data units from Linux to Android units based on sensor type.

methods.name: parseSensorConfiguration
methods.description: Parses and stores sensor configuration based on input device data.

methods.name: populateDeviceInfo
methods.description: Populates device info with sensor details.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the internal state of the sensor input mapper for debugging.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures sensor axes and device state based on new input configuration.

methods.name: createAxis
methods.description: Creates an axis object with calculated scale and offset based on raw axis info.

methods.name: createSensor
methods.description: Creates a sensor object with configuration info.

methods.name: processHardWareTimestamp
methods.description: Processes hardware timestamp events for sensors.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes raw input events and generates sensor notifications.

methods.name: setSensorEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific sensor.

methods.name: enableSensor
methods.description: Enables a sensor with specified sampling period and batch latency.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Generates synchronized sensor events based on current data.
